title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via :erlang.binary_to_term (elixir) — review required
description: In elixir, :erlang.binary_to_term performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The elixir-specific remedy is data-only decoding via Jason/JSON decoding or :safe option review.
applicability: elixir codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through :erlang.binary_to_term; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
